cases.name: Sproutwatch Dryad
cases.text: At the beginning of each combat, this creature gains flying until end of turn if a creature you control or a card in your hand has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.
